# Nanotrasen Colonial Law and Procedure
This page contains all Nanotrasen Colonial Law and Procedure articles.
Overview:
## Article 1: Station Regulations Covers general station behaviour: Alert levels, Permits, Paperwork, Hiring, Promotions and more.
## Article 2: Colonial Law Covers the list of crimes, searches, procedure for detainment and arrests, contraband clasifications and related topics.
## Article 3: Standard Operating Procedure Covers the Standard Operating Procedure for each role hired by Nanotrasen.
## Article 5: Sentencing, Trials, and Hearings Covers the process of convicting criminals.
